name: Nana
source:
Potential is unquestionable! The latest model with ultra-high specs

The latest and seventh generation of the "PLAYSTALLION" series of consumer dolls released by NCE.
It uses a newly developed high-performance processor for its CPU, and its potential is unrivaled.
Thanks to this processor, "Presta 7" can be customized in detail, even in terms of AI personality settings.
The Presta 7 is also a luxurious product, with state-of-the-art technology used throughout, but it is also very expensive.
The name "Nana" was given by the master, Shou, who was unintentionally harsh to Nana because her father, who was involved in the development of Nana's AI, was devoted to research and did not care about his family.
Even though Nana knows that Shou hates her, she does not know how to be sad, and since her raison d'etre is to serve others, she follows orders calmly and precisely.

[From Pikopiko's official website]
